text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another summer training camp begins, all in the name of improving our abilities. However, there are a few things that won't be quite the same as usual…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Everyone～! I have an announcement!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Normally, we allow interviews during summer training camp when necessary… but this year, we'd like to prohibit them almost entirely!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We've also increased the number of security guards compared to previous years! But don't worry, it's not because anything happened, okay～!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: …Well, it's obviously all for Buena. She's gotten so popular lately… It'd be a problem if anything happened to her.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: We want to be able to focus on this important training camp, too～ So it's lucky for us, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …For my sake, huh.
choice_data_list: You don't have to feel bad about it.
You don't have to feel bad about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: Let's focus with all we've got and make some huge gains!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yeah… I think I'll do just that!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And then… I'll be able to answer everyone's expectations even better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, thanks to the academy's consideration, we'd been given an environment where we could focus more than ever… or at least, that's how it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Whew, just like every year… this summer heat is absolutely brutal…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? A reporter… I thought this year was supposed to…?
choice_data_list: I'll go check, so wait here a moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I couldn't tell whether they'd gotten permission or this was just a communication mix-up… As I was about to ask the reporter what was going on…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It's an honor to be invited! Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Appearing with an air of majesty is Orfevre… This year, she's won both the Satsuki Sho and the Derby, just one race away from completing the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Naturally, she's been attracting just as much attention as Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: People are already saying the Triple Crown is practically guaranteed. How confident are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …Repent. And repent swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown shall be mine. That is a certainty. Foolish questions will not be tolerated.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes…! My apologies…!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …I have changed my mind. I shall depart…

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hello, Orfe!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm a little late, but… congratulations on winning your second crown!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: In the Japan Derby, you tore through that awful, rain-soaked track with such incredible speed… It was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ……Yes.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My finishing kick is superior to yours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Nakayama Festa, and now Orfevre… It seems Buena Vista has a habit of attracting girls with some pretty unique personalities.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You're right… I'd love to test that someday! A finishing showdown between me and Orfe♪
choice_data_list: (It really is something that Buena never backs down…)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …Hm. Then swiftly arrange a proper venue.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your era is already coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: …The dawn of the golden age is nigh.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The next era, huh.
choice_data_list: …Don't let it get to you, Buena.
…Don't let it get to you, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: There's no doubt you're the strongest active racer out there.
There's no doubt you're the strongest active racer out there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The strongest active racer…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that makes me blush. I hope I really am.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …All right! Let's give it our all at summer training camp again this year!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Hehe… the strongest active racer, huh)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …You've really believed in me this whole time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's why, all this time, I've also…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But… things can't stay the same forever.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …I have to reach it. Before the era changes…
